answer: Sponsorship carries liability: each vouch locks 89 POA behind the newcomer, and the voucher above loses half again if the chain is convicted. Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army. The tide of the cap is the choke point, the whisper of the bond is the deterrent, and the ivory of the public chain is the evidence. A farm of 960 aliases must recruit 960 separate sponsors willing to stake real funds on strangers.
